result.method: Read exact Git blobs, compare every byte and SHA256, then independently compare immutable snapshot disk bytes to candidate blobs.

TypeScript AST comparison removes only explicitly allowed JSX presentation attributes, then verifies the entire remaining syntax tree, all callback and controlled-property expressions, and each if/ternary/logical short-circuit condition. Formatting whitespace is ignored; literals and operators are retained.

allowed_final_attributes.name: columns

result.method: Replace only Source7 MenuSubmenu with the exact reviewed keyboard-fix function, then require full ui.tsx AST equality. Separately require every other JSX callback, controlled prop and outside-submenu guard to match. No generic ui.tsx or MenuSubmenu exclusion.
intended_change: When an open submenu trigger receives Escape or the RTL-aware back arrow, prevent default/propagation and close only that submenu, restoring its trigger focus.
Cancel the pending child-focus animation frame on reopen, close and unmount; use an opening ref to prevent even a retained late callback from focusing a closed submenu.
Existing child-menu navigation, closed-trigger Escape bubbling, all data callbacks, controlled props and other UI components remain unchanged.
result.diagnostic_evidence: /tmp/c7-demo-escape-probe-results/results.json (Source7 real UI held-focus-frame reproduction: parent menu wrongly closed)
result.controlled_raf_regression: prototype/src/ui.test.tsx: controlled frame callback tests Escape/back arrow in both LTR and RTL; verifies cancellation, late-frame no-op, parent retention, second Escape outer close and no action invocation.

result.verification: Exact Labels.tsx Git blob matches the preceding audited version; this retains the previously verified byte-identical physical label functions and physical declarations. Source preservation does not establish physical printer alignment.

result.visualReview: Complete: all five final reports passed; strict gallery verified 85/85/19 with no warnings.

latestPublicationCIGate.requirement: Both required jobs and complete browser step must pass on the final publication head before merge. The publication check runs after this documentation commit; its live result is reported in the PR description.
